headline: Names a post office building in Aurora, Illinois after Kenneth M. Christy.
what_it_does: This law officially designates the U.S. Postal Service facility at 525 N Broadway in Aurora, Illinois, as the "Kenneth M. Christy Post Office Building." It is a naming measure only. It does not change postal services, mail delivery, staffing, or the building's operations.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on July 15, 2016.
